description: Use this when someone asks whether a company's insiders (directors, officers and other managers, and large owners where the market counts them) bought or sold its shares, or what an executive did with theirs. Give it the ticker or name; optionally kind (market = open-market buys and sells, buys, sells, all) and since (first trade day). Returns trades newest first with insider, role, shares, price and value in the trade's currency, holding after the trade, whether a pre-set trading plan was used, trade and filing dates, the insider's 6ix page and the filing, plus buy and sell totals for the period, which never starts before 6ix's record of the market's insider filings.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

since.description: First trade day, YYYY-MM-DD (default a year back; never before 6ix's record of the market's insider filings)

name: get_company_insider_transactions

covered.description: False when 6ix doesn't read the insider dealings of the company's home market

recordFrom.description: The first day of 6ix's unbroken record of the insider filings this company's trades come from

records.description: home: when 6ix's record of the home market's insider dealings starts; us: when its record of US insider filings starts

url.description: The company's Insider trades page on 6ix

title: Insider buying and selling
